reviews.shade: April Skin Carrotene IPMP Hydromelt Cleansing Balm 90ml
reviews.text:
Always my go to makeup cleanser! I'ce purchased this one multiple times after using a different brand one for a while, I am glad I tried this one out. I can tell a different for my skin because it is much less irritated when I use this to remove makeup. 
Many other brands kr form of remover would leave my skin feeling slightly irritated or lightly red, however I do not experience that with this one. I usually wear light makeup one a day to day basis, with the rare occasion of waterproof eyeliner & mascara. But removes all of it always. 
Great for makeup removal. I would overall recommend if looking to use oil based cleanser for double cleanse at night too.
reviews.zh:
一直係我嘅御用卸妝產品！用過其他品牌一輪之後再回購呢支，好慶幸自己試咗呢支。用呢支卸妝嘅時候，明顯感覺到皮膚無咁受刺激。
好多其他品牌嘅卸妝產品用完都會令皮膚有少少刺激或者泛紅，但用呢支就完全唔會。我平時日日都係化淡妝，好少先會用防水眼線筆同睫毛液，但無論係邊種，佢都卸得乾乾淨淨。
好適合用嚟卸妝。如果你夜晚想用油性卸妝產品做雙重清潔，呢支我會整體推薦。
